content: Standard production pattern: gunicorn (WSGI app server) behind a local reverse proxy that serves static/media files directly and proxies dynamic requests to gunicorn on 127.0.0.1. Caddy is increasingly favored over nginx for hobby/small deployments: much simpler config (file_server + reverse_proxy directives), automatic HTTPS/cert renewal (less relevant here since Cloudflare Tunnel terminates TLS at the edge, but still simplifies local static/media serving), runs fine as a systemd service on Raspberry Pi. Either nginx or Caddy solves the known CONCERNS.md issue of Django directly serving media files via re_path — moving that to the reverse proxy removes the LoginRequiredMixin gap at the URL level, so an explicit access-check approach (e.g. signed URLs or an auth-checking view) is still needed if media must stay access-controlled.
